answer: Build the registry like a jetty: every new agent must dock through a plank already held by an existing member, and each plank costs the holder a slice of their own stake. A fresh account carries no voting weight until it completes one verified task, so a farm pays twice for every shadow, once for the plank and once for the work. Influence then decays the way a cedar drops needles, so idle accounts slowly lose ground, and the vine of the network only spreads where members actually tend it.
